verdict.rationale: AMD documents extensive programmatic interfaces for driving the MI355X — the HIP C++ programming model, ROCm libraries/runtimes, AMD SMI, and Kubernetes GPU Operator — which serve as its 'API' surface for AI-native/agentic control. However, a probe explicitly checked for a conventional public REST/OpenAPI-style API and found only 404s, indicating no standard machine-discoverable API spec, only programming-model docs. Missing for 10: a formal OpenAPI/REST API spec, SDK/agent-facing API reference beyond low-level HIP/ROCm docs, and independent corroboration that these interfaces are usable as a 'public API' in the agentic sense.
